newsitem.title: USA: NYS Local Gov't Authority mulls $330 mln refunding.
newsitem.headline: NYS Local Gov't Authority mulls $330 mln refunding.

text.p: New York State Local Government Assistance Corp is considering selling about $330.2 million of refunding bonds as soon as next week, said a state official on Friday.
The official, who declined to be named, added that Bear Stearns & Co is expected to be the book-runner.
The state official added a preliminary offering statement had been mailed.
A spokesman for the state comptroller was not immediately available to comment.
